title: Qwen3.5-0.8B, edited by an LLM with no training (Weight-Space Programming)
summary: Maintainer-produced canonical replacement representation of the published edit by Rikiya Takehi, Jayden Teoh, Alex Zhang and Omar Khattab to the language-model MLP down-projection tensors in layers 15 and 19 of Qwen3.5-0.8B, built from the pinned base and edited checkpoints without changing tensor dtype or replacement values.
